devices.name: Dry Water Massage Table with hood

devices.name: Ozone Hydrotherapy Spa Bath

devices.name: Children Hydrotherapy Tub

devices.name: Children Hydrotherapy Tub (LCD)

devices.name: Children Hydrotherapy Pool (gait)

devices.name: Baby Hydrotherapy Tub (microcomputer)

devices.name: Mobile Baby Swimming Tub

devices.name: Paraffin Wax Heater (semi-automatic, water bath)

devices.name: Colourful Drawing Board (easel)

devices.form: Natural-wood A-frame easel with a whiteboard (~450×550) in a multicolour frame (green left, red bottom, yellow top, blue right), front legs with green round knobs at hinges, a low wooden shelf tray between the legs ~250 above floor.

devices.name: Multifunctional Cognitive Assembly (table with stools)

Two triangular gusset braces (dark green/black) and a front sloped foot wedge at the base. A small white label plate at the top ('FUSHOU'). Child is strapped to the front face (no straps visible).

devices.name: Exercise Bicycle (children)

devices.name: Space Walker (children air walker)

Two swinging pendulum legs of blue foam-covered tube (#2a5db0) hang from the top cross bars, each ending in a blue foot platform (~250×150). Uprights wrapped in red/blue foam sleeves.

devices.name: Treadmill (children, manual)
